GHQ Spokesperson《Citizens of Kamakura, kindly listen. We, the occupation forces, have absolutely no intention of causing you any harm.》
GHQ Spokesperson《We are here to liberate you.》
GHQ Spokesperson《The Rokuhara shogunate is not a lawful government recognized by the International League for Universal Peace and Prosperity. It is an unlawful organization of plunderers, using military force to rule over you and make you suffer.》
GHQ Spokesperson《We, the occupation forces in Yamato, will remove Rokuhara and restore your rightful rights...》
GHQ Spokesperson《Citizens, please follow the instructions of the patrolling soldiers. Kindly do not go out. Remain at your residence, place of work, nearest shop, or similar premises.》
GHQ Spokesperson《If you go outside, you may become involved in the fighting. Going outside is therefore not advised. Please remain inside.》
GHQ Spokesperson《With your cooperation, the occupation forces will certainly ensure the safety of Kamakura. Fighting with Rokuhara will be confined to the surroundings of Fudaraku Castle and should conclude in a very short time.》
GHQ Spokesperson《Kindly bear with us for a little while. Citizens, your cooperation is requested.》
GHQ Spokesperson《In case of shortage of food or other daily necessities, please inform the patrolling soldiers. The required quantity will be supplied...》

en.html:
Chief"Those are not the troops that came up from the coast."
Prince Maidono"Direct from Yokohama by land, you think?"
Chief"Most likely."
Prince Maidono"Not many of them, though. Equipment also looks light, na."
Chief"Presumably they have sent the civilian-relations team ahead to settle people's nerves. The main force may be coming behind."
Prince Maidono"So, Kamakura is getting occupied..."
Chief"Very efficient work. They must have planned it in minute detail and practiced thoroughly somewhere."
Chief"They seem to be avoiding confrontations with the citizens most skillfully."
Prince Maidono"Achha. Well, that much is good. But..."
Prince Maidono"What a situation we have landed in, yaar."
Chief"Indeed. Though thanks to it, we ourselves were saved..."
Prince Maidono"Can't exactly start celebrating, can we."
Chief"No."
Prince Maidono"Your station, everything all right there?"
Chief"I sent a messenger earlier. Told them to follow the occupation forces' instructions."
Chief"And if any troublesome cooperation is requested, they are to use my absence as protection and keep the answer pending. Very politely, very pending."
Prince Maidono"Arre, good. Your absence is doing useful work."
Chief"..."

ja.html:
署長「あれは海岸から上がって来た軍集団とは別 ですね」
舞殿宮「横浜から、陸路で直接来た連中かな？」
署長「おそらく」
舞殿宮「数は少ないようやけど。 　装備も軽そうな感じやね」
署長「市民の動揺を鎮めるための宣撫班だけ先に 寄越したのでしょう。 　後から本隊が来るのでは」
舞殿宮「鎌倉は占領されるか……」
署長「大した手際ですよ。 　余程に綿密な計画を立て、何処かで訓練も 積んでいたに違いありません」
署長「市民との衝突は巧妙に避けられているよう です」
舞殿宮「そうか。ま、それは何よりや。 　けど……」
舞殿宮「えらいことになったねえ」
署長「全くです。 　お陰で救われもしましたが……」
舞殿宮「喜んでもいられんなァ」
署長「はい」
舞殿宮「署の方はええんか？」
署長「先程、使いをやりました。 　進駐軍の指示に従うよう」
署長「何か厄介な協力を求められた場合は、私の 不在を盾にしてうまく返事を引き延ばせとも 言ってあります」
舞殿宮「そらええな」
署長「…………」

en.html:
Prince Maidono"Kikuchi..."
Chief"Yes?"
Prince Maidono"It has started, hasn't it..."
Chief"...Yes. Unfortunately."
Prince Maidono"War starting—that one thing, I wanted to avoid."
Chief"Now there is no helping it. The situation is what it is; we must accept it."
Chief"Then do the best we can within it. That much remains in our hands."
Prince Maidono"Haan. Same thing we used to do on the battlefield, long ago."
Chief"Yes."
Prince Maidono"You think those fellows will come to me also?"
Chief"They probably will. We must anticipate what they will ask for, and decide how to respond."
Prince Maidono"Hmm... By the way."
Prince Maidono"Kuronose Douji and Ichijou, how are they?"
Chief"They are receiving treatment inside. Both are armored warriors, so recovery should not take very long."
Prince Maidono"Achha, good. Then..."
Chief"Yes?"
Prince Maidono"...And our Muramasa didi?"
Chief"..."

ja.html:
舞殿宮「菊池ぃ」
署長「はい」
舞殿宮「始まってもうたね……」
署長「……ええ。残念ながら」
舞殿宮「開戦だけは避けたかったんやけど」
署長「今はもう、仕方ありません。 　状況は状況として受け入れましょう」
署長「その上で、最善を尽くすのみです」
舞殿宮「そやな。 　昔、戦場でもそうしとったもんな」
署長「はい」
舞殿宮「連中、わしんとこにも来るかな」
署長「来るでしょう。 　向こうの要望を予測し、対応を考えておか なくてはなりません」
舞殿宮「うん……。 　ところで」
舞殿宮「黒瀬童子と、一条さんはどうしてる？」
署長「奥で治療を受けています。 　二人とも武者ですから、そう時間は掛けず 回復するでしょう」
舞殿宮「そか、ならええ。 　で」
署長「はい？」
舞殿宮「……村正の姉ちゃんは？」
署長「…………」
